HTTP/2 error codes, forward declarations, and an error-string function.

# Purpose
This header file defines the base interface for the HTTP/2 support code. It sets the `FD_H2_HAS_SOCKETS` configuration flag, declares the main HTTP/2 object types with forward declarations, and defines the standard `FD_H2_ERR_*` error codes used by the implementation. It also declares [`fd_h2_strerror`](<#fd_h2_strerror>), which returns a static string for a given HTTP/2 error code.
